# temps_node_public_ingress (Resource)

Whether a worker node accepts visitors' HTTP and HTTPS traffic directly, and on which address and ports. Destroying the resource leaves the setting as it is.

Import with `<node_id>`.

Required API key permissions: `settings:read`, `settings:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_node_public_ingress" "edge" {
  node_id = 3
  enabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Accept public traffic on the node.
- `node_id` (Number) ID of a worker node. The control plane (`0`) has no direct worker ingress: its own listeners are set when Temps starts.

### Optional

- `http_port` (Number) HTTP port.
- `https_port` (Number) HTTPS port.
- `listen_address` (String) Local address to listen on; every address when unset.
- `public_address` (String) Address visitors reach; detected when unset.

### Read-Only

- `effective_public_address` (String) Address in use.
- `id` (String) Import ID, `<node_id>`.
- `running` (Boolean) Whether the listener runs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <node_id>
terraform import temps_node_public_ingress.edge 3
```
